Setting.Title: Shelve It
Setting.Desc.EnableSuggestions: Suggest libraries built from themes detected in your installed assets.
Setting.Desc.MinAssetsPerSuggestion: A theme is suggested only when at least this many installed assets match it.
Setting.Desc.Rescan: Scan all installed assets again and rebuild the suggestions, ignoring the cache. Works once a city or the editor is loaded.
Setting.Desc.ExportLibraries: Write one JSON file per library to ModsData\ShelveIt\Export.
Setting.Desc.ImportLibraries: Import every JSON file found in ModsData\ShelveIt\Import.
Setting.Desc.ExportContribution: Write contribution.json to the Export folder. It lists the assets of your libraries created from suggestions, ready to share with the community data.
ShelveIt.UI[EmptyHint]: Browse all assets and press + on a tile, or pick an asset in the game and press Add current asset.
ShelveIt.UI[NoSuggestions]: No suggestions right now. Install more assets and press Rescan to look for new themes.
ShelveIt.UI[SuggestionsPending]: Suggestions appear here when the scan is finished.
ShelveIt.UI[NoLibraries]: No libraries yet. Type a name above and press Enter, or create one from a suggestion.
ShelveIt.UI[NoSelection]: Select a library or a suggestion on the left to see its assets.
ShelveIt.UI[NoAssets]: None of the assets of this theme are installed.
ShelveIt.UI[AddActiveTip]: Add the asset currently selected for placement to this library.
ShelveIt.UI[ExportTip]: Write this library as a JSON file to ModsData\ShelveIt\Export.
ShelveIt.UI[ImportTip]: Import every JSON file found in ModsData\ShelveIt\Import.
ShelveIt.UI[ContributionTip]: Write contribution.json to the Export folder, listing the assets of your libraries created from suggestions.
ShelveIt.UI[RescanTip]: Scan all installed assets again and rebuild the suggestions.
ShelveIt.UI[MoreOptions]: {COUNT} more. Type above to narrow the list.
ShelveIt.UI[NothingScanned]: No assets found yet. They appear here when the scan is finished.
ShelveIt.UI[SaveAsLibraryTip]: Create a library from every asset the search and filters leave.
ShelveIt.UI[NoMatchesHint]: Remove a filter or shorten the search to see assets again.
ShelveIt.UI[ToPalette]: Switch to the palette, a compact view that stays open while you build
ShelveIt.UI[EmptyPaletteHint]: Add assets to it in the manager.
ShelveIt.UI[PaletteHint]: Pick one from the list above to place its assets.
ShelveIt.UI[PaletteNoLibraries]: Create a library in the manager, or accept a suggestion.
ShelveIt.UI[AcceptTip]: Create a library with these assets. You can edit it afterwards.
ShelveIt.UI[FindItMissing]: Find It is not installed. With Find It, a library can be listed there with lib:<library>.
ShelveIt.UI[OpenInFindItTip]: List this library in the Find It panel.
Setting.Desc.ServerUrl: Address of the server that hosts community libraries. Leave the default unless you run your own server.
Setting.Label.CommunityNote: Shelve It contacts this server only when you use a Community feature: opening the Community tab, searching, opening, importing, publishing, reporting or unpublishing a library. Nothing is sent at startup or in the background.
Setting.Desc.ResetServerUrl: Use the default community server again.
ShelveIt.UI[ServerOffline]: The community server does not answer. Share codes still work.
ShelveIt.UI[ServerUnknown]: The server is contacted only while you use this tab.
ShelveIt.UI[PdxUnavailable]: Paradox Mods is not available in this session. Browsing and share codes still work.
ShelveIt.UI[PdxSignedInAs]: Signed in to Paradox as {NAME}. You can publish your libraries.
ShelveIt.UI[PdxSignedOut]: Not signed in to Paradox. Sign in from the main menu to publish.
ShelveIt.UI[CommunityPrivacy]: Published libraries show your Paradox display name.
ShelveIt.UI[ServerUnreachableHint]: The community server did not answer. Use a share code instead: ask for the code and paste it with Import code.
ShelveIt.UI[NoCommunity]: Nobody has published a library yet. Share one of yours from its Share button.
ShelveIt.UI[ImportLibraryTip]: Add this library to yours. Assets you do not have stay in it and appear once installed.
ShelveIt.UI[ReportTip]: Tell the moderators about a problem with this library.
ShelveIt.UI[NotScannedYet]: Your assets have not been scanned yet, so installed and missing counts are incomplete. Load a city to scan.
ShelveIt.UI[MissingNoPackages]: {COUNT} assets are missing and their package is not known. They may come from the base game or a removed mod.
ShelveIt.UI[ConfirmSubscribe]: Subscribe to {COUNT} packages on Paradox Mods? Asset packages load as soon as they are downloaded; a few may need a restart.
ShelveIt.UI[PdxUnavailableHint]: Paradox Mods is not available, so packages cannot be opened or subscribed from here.
ShelveIt.UI[DoneCode]: Imported from the share code with {COUNT} assets.
ShelveIt.UI[DoneSubscribe]: Subscribed to {COUNT} packages. They load as soon as each download completes.
ShelveIt.UI[PackagesNeedRestart]: {COUNT} packages need a restart before they can be used.
ShelveIt.UI[DoneCopy]: Share code copied with {COUNT} assets. Paste it anywhere to share.
ShelveIt.UI[DoneForget]: This library is no longer marked as published by you.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrNetwork]: The community server could not be reached.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrTimeout]: The community server did not answer in time.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrRate]: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrTooLarge]: This library is too large to publish. Share it with a code instead.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrNotFound]: This library is no longer on the server.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrServer]: The server answered with an error. Try again later.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrName]: The library name needs 3 to 60 characters to be published.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrNotLoggedIn]: Sign in to Paradox to publish.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrPdxUnavailable]: Paradox Mods is not available in this session.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrSubscribe]: Subscribing failed. Try again from Paradox Mods.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrClipboard]: The clipboard could not be used.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrCodeFormat]: This is not a valid share code. Copy the whole code, starting with SHELVE1:.
ShelveIt.UI[ErrCodeSchema]: This code was made by a newer version of Shelve It. Update the mod to import it.
ShelveIt.UI[PasteTip]: Paste the code from the clipboard.
ShelveIt.UI[ImportCodeTip]: Import a library from a share code.
ShelveIt.UI[ShareTip]: Publish this library or copy a share code.
ShelveIt.UI[PublishTip]: Publish this library to the community server under your Paradox name.
ShelveIt.UI[UpdateTip]: Replace the published version with the current content.
ShelveIt.UI[ConfirmUnpublish]: Remove it from the community server?
ShelveIt.UI[PublishNeedsLogin]: Sign in to Paradox from the main menu to publish. You can still copy a share code.
ShelveIt.UI[PublishNeedsPdx]: Paradox Mods is not available, so you cannot publish. You can still copy a share code.
ShelveIt.UI[CopyCodeTip]: Copy a code that works without the server.
ShelveIt.UI[ForgetPublishedTip]: The server no longer accepts your changes to it. Stop treating this library as published by you.
